question: A cement mill reports increased separator fan electricity per tonne after replacing several filter bags, while product Blaine and mill throughput are stable. How can an agent separate fan operating-point shift, false-air ingress, filter resistance, and electrical metering allocation before recommending a variable-speed-drive retrofit?
category: Cement mill separator fan energy attribution after filter maintenance
scenario: Separator circuit fan specific power rises following bag replacement without a corresponding cement quality or throughput change
evidence_required: Before/after fan speed, damper position, static pressures, differential pressure across filter and separator, gas temperature and flow traverses at matched mill load
Bag specification, installation and leak-test records, false-air inspection, oxygen/temperature trends and fan performance curve for the installed impeller
Calibrated fan feeder kW/kWh trends, auxiliary feeder allocation, power factor, mill tonnes, product fineness and matched shift production records
answer_and_decision_guide: Normalize fan energy to verified tonnes and compare matched operating conditions. Check meter boundary and auxiliary loads first. Use measured pressure-flow operating points and fan curve to distinguish higher resistance, damper changes and density or false-air effects; verify filter bag fit and leakage without overriding dust-control protections. Treat the timing of bag replacement as a hypothesis, not causation. Only qualified plant engineers may authorize safe flow tests or controls changes.
source_provenance: Seller-maintained source directory offers general discovery, not a validated fan curve or filter OEM manual; require installed equipment documents and calibrated site data.
free_first_decision: Use historian, electrical meter, filter service and available fan-curve records before paying for reference material or proposing a VSD.

conditional_paid_check.authorization: Check exact relevant inventory file, edition, permissions and price; obtain explicit buyer approval before any paid choice. No automated purchase.

model_limitations: Without calibrated gas flow, fan curve, power-meter boundaries and matched operating points, AI cannot quantify the cause, VSD savings or payback.
